description: This file defines the EntityUniqueProperty class, which extends an abstract rule class and implements a validation rule to check the uniqueness of a property within an entity. The class uses Doctrine Query Builder to query the database for existing entities with matching property values, considering options for trimming, matched values, and ignored values.

classes.name: EntityUniqueProperty
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks whether a specified property value is unique within a given entity, with options for trimming and matching behaviors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EntityUniqueProperty with the entity name, property, and optional matching options.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs the validation to determine if the input property value is unique within the entity, considering configured options.
